rationale: The previous candidate cautiously reduced kp to 0.48 and increased ki to 0.04, with sensor_weights at [-0.35,0.55,-0.35] and line_loss set to 'search_left'. Evaluator feedback recommended increasing kd from 0.22 to 0.25 to add more damping and reduce residual oscillations, adjusting sensor_weights to [-0.3,0.6,-0.3] to further emphasize the central sensor and reduce side sensor influence for smoother steering, and switching line_loss back to 'last_direction' to improve recovery from line loss events. I implemented these changes accordingly, keeping base_speed at 0.75 to balance speed and stability. I expect these adjustments to reduce steering oscillations further, improve steady-state error correction, and enhance line loss recovery, leading to better overall line following stability and performance. I request telemetry on steering_oscillation, rms_error, line_loss_events, completion, progress, and completion_time to verify these hypotheses in the next race.
